title: Weekly Team Standup
summary: Weekly team standup meeting covering sprint progress, design updates, QA status, and marketing preparations. The team is on track for the February 1st launch. Key focus areas include completing payment integration, finalizing dashboard design with stakeholder approval, and preparing launch materials.

Preparing launch campaign materials. Need final screenshots from design by end of week.
